title: My accepted Deal
subtitle: {originCity} → {destinationCity} · {date}

banner.title: You''re engaged on this Deal
banner.subtitle: {shipperFirstName} has been notified · it''s up to you to set the pickup meeting

h1Subtitle: Here are the next steps and what to do first.

contactCard.title: Contact {shipperFirstName} to set the meeting
contactCard.description: Before your flight on {flightDate}, you need to agree on a date, time and exact location for the parcel handover. {shipperFirstName} suggests {pickupLocation}.

recap.title: DEAL DETAILS
recap.shipperMeta: ⭐ {rating} · {count, plural, =1 {# shipment} other {# shipments}} · {verified, select, true {Verified} other {}}
recap.deliveryRecipientNote: Phone shared to set the meeting on arrival

items.beforeFlight: **Before your flight.** You meet {shipperFirstName} at the agreed time and place. You inspect the content, take your photos, then confirm pickup in the app.
items.secretCode: **The code stays secret.** You don''t see the delivery code. {shipperFirstName} reveals it to {recipientFirstName} when you confirm pickup.
items.duringTrip: **During the trip.** You can notify {shipperFirstName} of your progress (takeoff, landing) to reassure them. It''s optional.
items.onArrival: **On arrival.** You meet {recipientFirstName}, she gives you the 6-digit code, you enter it in the app to validate delivery.
items.afterDays: **{days} days later.** If everything goes well, your €{amount} payment is released to your Stripe account.

payment.title: YOUR PAYMENT
payment.note: The payout leaves after the shipper's verification period, then reaches your bank account within 2 to 7 days.

scheduled.title: {amount} after verification
scheduled.text: The shipper has until {date} to check the parcel. Without a report, your payout leaves automatically on that date.

pending.title: {amount} being processed
pending.text: The transaction is closed, the payout is being sent to your account. Nothing to do.

sent.title: {amount} on its way to your account
sent.text: Sent on {date}. Depending on your bank, the money shows up on your bank account within 2 to 7 days.

accountNotReady.title: {amount} on hold: finish your Stripe account
accountNotReady.text: Your payment account is not ready to receive transfers yet. Finish your Stripe onboarding: the payout will leave automatically within minutes.

retrying.title: {amount} being processed
retrying.text: The payout is retried automatically. Nothing to do on your side; we will let you know as soon as it leaves.

frozen.title: {amount} on hold
frozen.text: A report is under review: the payout is on hold until the decision. This is not a decision.

delivered.bannerSub: Validated on {date} with the delivery code.
delivered.h1Subtitle: {shipperFirstName} has a short period to check the parcel, then your payout leaves.
delivered.verificationNote: During this period, {shipperFirstName} can confirm earlier or report an issue. Without action, your payout leaves on {date}.

completed.bannerSubSystem: Verification period ended on {date}, with no report.
completed.h1Subtitle: Thank you for this transport. Here is where your payout stands.
completed.ratingSoon: Soon you will be able to rate {shipperFirstName} from this screen.

disputed.bannerSub: Opened on {date}. Your payout is on hold during the review.
disputed.h1Subtitle: {shipperFirstName} reported an issue with this parcel. We will collect your side before deciding.
disputed.notADecision: This is not a decision: the payout is simply on hold during the review. We hear both parties.

steps.1: We acknowledge the shipper's report within 48 business hours.
steps.2: We contact you for your side and your evidence (pickup and handover photos, exchanges).
steps.3: We decide within 5 business days and let you know by email.

support.title: Give your side right now
support.text: Write to us quoting case {ticket}: your side and your photos are added to the review.
